A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the concentrated winding motor with the same number of poles as the distributed windings motor has higher power factor, lower iron losses, higher efficiency, lower torque ripple and lower cogging torque.
concentrated winding with ferrite magnet rotor is better solution than distributed winding with NdFeB magnet rotor.
motor A with concentrated winding has better efficiency, lower torque pulsations and lower torque ripple than motor B with distributed windings.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the concentrated winding is a better option for low-speed PMSM with ferrite magnets.
motor A with concentrated winding and ferrite magnets can be a good alternative for motor B with distributed winding and NdFeB magnets in some specific applications.
motor A with concentrated winding and ferrite magnets is more advantageous for the application with high number of poles (e.g. 12, 24).
